Asset type: transparent foreground character group for an existing HOME room card.
Input image 1 is the original poster, the PRIMARY and ONLY reference for the exact character identities, clothes, facial expressions, hair rendering, colors and illustration atmosphere. Regenerate ONLY the three characters as a complete clean cutout. The website already has a separate classroom background and title.
Keep the left-to-right identities: Sua with the short dark bob, Chaerin with very long pale blonde hair in the middle, Dahee with the high brown ponytail on the right. Faithfully match the poster's delicate, detailed anime painting, faces, reflective hair and bright gently warm classroom lighting. Sua is softly friendly, Chaerin looks reserved and rests her cheek lightly on one hand, Dahee has a cheerful smile and holds her pen.
IMPORTANT CLOTHING MATCH: Sua wears the original white long-sleeved collared shirt under her dark gray plaid V-neck vest, with the original black tie. Chaerin wears the original WHITE long-sleeved shirt and relaxed BLACK tie, with NO cardigan, no sweater and no vest added. Dahee wears the original WHITE collared outfit with the distinctive BLACK STRIPES along the shoulders and sleeves and black tie, with NO plain black cardigan replacing it. Match the poster's collar styling and natural loose fabric, without increasing the collar opening. Use normal school-uniform plaid skirts with opaque dark tights and loafers where visible, not the calf-length skirts or buttoned black cardigans of a redesign.
Pose: modest, relaxed, eye-level seated-floor composition. All three sit directly on an IMPLIED flat floor in natural kneeling/seiza poses: hips resting above tucked heels, knees together low on the floor, shins folded underneath and ankles behind. Skirts drape naturally over the lap and cover the upper legs; legs are not lifted toward the camera, not crossed in front and not emphasized. Small notebooks rest naturally in their laps. Keep upright friendly upper bodies, faces prominent and heads at similar heights. Exactly two anatomically natural arms and legs for each person, no extra or fused limbs.
Landscape 1536x1024, the whole group and all hair/clothing/body silhouettes fit within a small transparent safety margin.
STRICT EXCLUSIONS: NO chair, stool, seat, bench, cushion, furniture, table, desk, floor plane, room, scenery, background haze, colored glow behind the silhouettes, ground shadow, title, name labels, logos, readable text, watermark or UI. Genuine alpha transparency outside and between the three people. Only the three character cutouts with their small notebooks and pen. Preserve the poster clothing and atmosphere while keeping the pose calm and modest.
